Lobbying Activity

Tell us about your current lobbying activity. Complete all that apply. You must choose at least one option:

Legislative proposal   No

Bill or resolution   Yes

Describe your lobbying goal(s) in detail. What are you attempting to influence or accomplish as a result of your communications with Ontario public office holders?

The OHA lobbies on bills that may impact hospitals and the health care system, including but not limited to bills addressing hospital funding, health research and education, hospital operations, labour relations, regulation of health professionals, privacy, not-for-profit corporations, broader public sector organizations, and health system integration.

Regulation   Yes

Describe your lobbying goal(s) in detail. What are you attempting to influence or accomplish as a result of your communications with Ontario public office holders?

Monitoring regulatory proposals that may impact the hospital and wider health care sector, including but not limited to: regulations under the Public Hospitals Act; regulations or directives under the Broader Public Sector Accountability Act; regulations under the Personal Health Information Protection Act; regulations under the Occupational Health and Safety Act; regulations under Regulated Health Professions Act; regulations under Public Sector Labour Relations Transition Act; regulations under the Connecting Care Act; regulations under the Not-for-Profit Corporations Act; regulations under the Integrated Community Health Services Centres Act, and regulations under the Fixing Long-Term Care Act.

Policy and/or program   Yes

Describe your lobbying goal(s) in detail. What are you attempting to influence or accomplish as a result of your communications with Ontario public office holders?

Lobbying with respect to policies for workplace safety and pension reform, emergency department (ED) operations, health human resource capacity, management of Alternate-Level-of-Care (ALC) patients, including co-payment and per diem matters; health system reform as it relates to hospital funding; patient-based payment/hospital funding; standing orders on hospital pharmacies and drug procurement; health system reconfiguration (health hubs and bundled payments)/OHTs; enhancements to home and community care; seniors care; increases to mental health services; medical assistance in dying policy, health research funding, including but not limited to the Ontario Research Fund; clinical trials.
